events.title: Football (soccer): 레알 마드리드 (from Spain ) defeats Olimpia (from Paraguay ) to win the Intercontinental Cup of 2002 .
레알 마드리드 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan for the third time, by defeating Paraguay 's Olimpia Asunción : 2–0.
맨체스터 유나이티드's revival continues with a 2–0 home league win over defending champions 아스널.

맨체스터 유나이티드 continue to close in on the top of the table with a 3–0 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 선덜랜드 boost their survival challenge with a 2–1 home win over 리버풀, whose title challenge is continuing to fall away. Marc-Vivien Foé scores twice for 맨체스터 시티 in a 2–2 draw at 찰턴 애슬레틱.

Football mourns the deaths of Football Association chairman Sir Bert Millichip , 88, and former 레스터 시티 and 슈루즈버리 타운 striker Arthur Rowley, 76, who scored a record 434 English league goals during his 19-year career.
헐 시티 celebrate their first competitive game at their new Kingston Communications Stadium with a 2–0 win over 하틀리풀 유나이티드 in Division Three .

2002 ends with 아스널 top of the Premier League, four points ahead of second-placed 첼시 and with a game in hand. 맨체스터 유나이티드 occupy third place, 에버턴 are fourth and 리버풀 have declined to fifth place just two months after they had a comfortable lead at the top. 사우샘프턴's recent resurgence is putting pressure on the top five as they occupy seventh place and look on course for their highest finish since 1995. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 remain bottom and are still looking for their first home win of the season, while 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 선덜랜드 complete the bottom three. 포츠머스 and 레스터 시티's two-horse race at the top of Division One continues, with the playoff zone unchanged from last month.
